description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Welamboda, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - (25/5514087)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for specific land parcels (Nos. 4:84 and 4:85) in Kandy District. It contains detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extent, owner names, and addresses, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
